note: IDs are for code; instructions carry meaning. Ask with symbol_fanout_questions() in the same evaluate() call.

instructions.question: Given named remint, occupancy COUNT, alive_menu, affinity, cost, session, and last exit class, choose one action for this candidate.
instructions.focus: Action after same-symbol same-sleeve orig_stops on this session day.
instructions.not_the_counter: You are not the orig_stop counter. remint.orig_stops_today and occupancy.same_sleeve_orig_stops_utc_day stay integers from closed[].
instructions.reprint_vs_remint: A legal 15-minute isolated reprint of a different sleeve, or a KEEP-family spring reprint, is not a remint.
instructions.news: If news_join is STATE_MISSING you do not know events. Do not invent HIGH or NEWS_PROTOCOL.
instructions.unknown_count: If remint.two_stop_source is closed_absent and remint.family_in_wmb_scope is true, prefer STAND.
instructions.hard_off: If hard_off_hit is named, STAND. Hard-offs are not yours to soften.

STAND.what: Refuse this remint. Same-sleeve orig_stop budget is spent for the session day, COUNT is unknown in-scope, or named state says the setup is spent.
STAND.not_for: A legal isolated reprint of another sleeve (that is SWITCH_SLEEVE) or a KEEP spring reprint.
examples: XAU dsp_two_bar_thrust_into_20high_continues already has 2 orig_stops today
closed[] absent and sleeve contains isolated_spike

REMINT_OK.what: Named state says this same-sleeve fire is still a new +EV fire, not a spent remint.
REMINT_OK.not_for: WMB bleed families after 2 orig_stops unless Challenge hist later proves an exception. Not an other-sleeve reprint.
examples: Rare: same sleeve, n>=2, but named structure/session/cost say a fresh fire — only after hist-prove APPLY

SWITCH_SLEEVE.what: This sleeve is spent. Another named alive_menu sleeve on this symbol is the fire. LABEL that sleeve. Do not auto-place.
SWITCH_SLEEVE.not_for: Reminting the spent sleeve. Not a global sleeve_select APPLY flip.
examples: two_bar spent; spring or three_fresh named on alive_menu for XAU

FLATTEN_SIBLING.what: An open sibling on this symbol or cluster is the problem. LABEL flatten candidate. Do not send flatten.
FLATTEN_SIBLING.not_for: A flat book (keep-one already flat). Do not invent an open sibling.

remint_continuation_quality.instructions: Score whether named state looks like a spent same-setup remint, mixed/unknown, or a fresh other-sleeve reprint. Use only named fields. regime_tag PENDING or null is unknown — do not invent ATR/regime. Score does not refuse.
criteria: Spent same setup — third orig_stop likely
